subject: [PATCH v8 6/7] mm/memcontrol: add stock to the memsw page counter

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This patch adds a separate stock to the memsw page counter, allowing it to operate independently of the memory bank. The common drain scheduling is factored into schedule_stock_drain(), which handles both stocks uniformly. If memory charge fails, only the nr_pages from memsw are rolled back. This change enables the raw counters for memory and memsw to temporarily drift due to cached amounts, while preserving the user-visible cgroup-v1 invariant.
